title: EstimatorConfig
description: Mechanism, parameters and uncertainty of the onboard estimator. First-class data, not an implementation detail: H1 is an agreement analysis between two uncertain estimates, so the configuration of one of them is part of the measurement. See docs/adr/0003.

reconstructible.description: Whether the configuration could actually be recovered from the log. False is a legitimate and informative value.

wind_estimation_mechanism.description: Fixed-wing typically fuses airspeed and synthetic sideslip; multicopter infers from drag specific forces, which requires calibrated drag coefficients.

drag_coefficients_present.description: Presence of the parameters, not evidence that they are correctly calibrated. Whether they are is generally not recoverable from the log.

parameters.description: Relevant autopilot parameters as logged, verbatim.

reported_variance.description: Summary of the estimator-reported wind variance over the run.
